OUR JOURNEY — EST. 2006

Two decades of building together.

From a small team taking on coastal homes in the Bay of Plenty, to a recognised architectural builder trusted with some of the region's most complex sites — our story is one of patient craft, steady growth, and people who have stayed the course.

2006
Three unique skillsets combined.
Aaron brought expertise in geotechnically challenging environments. Gavin returned with high-end European building knowledge. Pete contributed finance and governance rigour. One shared vision across three disciplines.
Complementary strengths, unified standards.
2006
Thorne Group was established.
The GFC hit months after we started. Those early years were hard. But they taught us something invaluable: how to identify unnecessary costs and help our clients optimise their budgets without compromising quality.
Building smarter, not just bigger.
2006 to 2024
Nearly 400 homes for families who wanted to downsize.
Not downspec. Homes built with the same precision and care as our largest projects. Word of mouth was doing the work across the Bay.
400+ completed homes built to our exacting standards.
Early Years
A direction that let us apply what we knew.
Larger projects gave us the opportunity to bring our processes together properly. More attention in how homes felt, not just how they were built. More considered. From the inside out.
Process over polish.
10+ Years Ago
One of the first to introduce online client portals.
Real-time access to your project. Schedules, updates, decisions. All in one place. No chasing. No guessing.
Live project visibility built in from the start.
15 Years Ago
Craig joined the team.
Craig brought exceptional craftsmanship from a career as a furniture maker for the Fortnum Mason family in London. We combined his meticulous attention to detail with the latest technology. A turning point in how we built high-end homes.
Craftsmanship meets innovation.
Continued Evolution
Architectural detailing meets space optimisation.
We continued to refine our approach, creating homes where every detail matters. Thoughtful spatial design that maximises livability without compromising the aesthetic or craftsmanship that define Thorne Group homes.
Beautiful homes that live beautifully.
Recent Years
What lies beneath.
Ange from What Lies Beneath did a deep dive with our prior clients, working through every aspect of our process to understand their experience and where we could do better.
That work still shapes how we operate today.
Over Time
100+ written and video testimonials.
From families who wanted to downsize to those building their forever homes. Every testimonial is a story of trust, attention to detail, and the relationships we've built. Our clients' voices matter more than any award.
Their words drive everything we do.
Along the Way
Recognition.
Multiple Master Builders House of the Year awards. Most Trusted Architectural Builder in the Bay of Plenty, five years running.
Awards that mean something because they come from peers.
2020
The end of an era.
Bob passed away and significant projects were completed not long after. A project timeline that had been decades in the making.
The values behind it haven't changed.
Today
20 years on.
Over the past 20 years there have been incredible highs and the kind of lows that make you question everything. What saw us through was our clients.
Those lessons are now built into how we work—on site and behind the scenes.
Looking Forward
The team continues to expand.
Exceptionally talented builders and craftspeople who share our values and passion for creating homes that matter. We grow carefully, with people who understand that quality, integrity, and client relationships come first.
Our strength is our people.
